payload.text: For hv, pplr-dc's finding landing Molt 0086, 2026-11-04: intent's issue verbs (new and close) each printed 'wrote: intent/.intentfiles' and left the file as HEAD had it, so a landing script that takes its path set from the wrote: lines expects a change that is not there. pplr-dc confirmed the fix commit by hand and landed the release by the same script. The fix is Intent's: a wrote: line only for a file the verb changed.
